thread:
Sam K.: hi! starting my first change — small bugfix in packages/api-client. quick q: which branch should i target (main/staging/feature)? and who do i @ for reviews? also do we need a signed-off commit message or a specific prefix?
Mira: welcome! :wave: For tiny fixes target `staging` unless the ticket says hotfix. Otherwise use `feature/<ticket>-short-desc`.
Mira: reviewers usually: @Jen L. for client libs, @Dylan for infra-related bits.
Sam K.: thanks — do we squash or keep history?
Jen L.: squash on merge is our default. Keep separate commits while iterating, but we'll squash when merging.
Dylan: also run `yarn lint --fix` and `yarn test:unit` locally. CI will block otherwise.
Sam K.: got it. any required commit message format?
Mira: no strict DCO, just please use this pattern: `pkg(api-client): short description (#TICKET)`
Mira: example:```
pkg(api-client): fix header encoding issue (#X-123)
```
Sam K.: thanks! one more: which branch protection rules should I be aware of?
Dylan: `staging` and `main` require 1 approving review + CI green. `main` also needs us to have changelog entry for public changes.
CI Bot: CI started for branch feature/X-123-sam. unit tests: running · lint: running
Sam K.: great — i'll open the PR against `staging` and tag Jen/Dylan. appreciate the help :slightly_smiling_face:
Jen L.: welcome aboard — ping me if you want a quick PR walkthrough before marking ready.
Sam K.: will do, thanks everyone! :party_parrot:
